title: Print jobs stay in the queue on the second floor
scenario: A print-server queue blocked by a corrupt job: an ordinary support case for a workload that has no knowledge pack, so the engine has to refuse it.

events.title: Printing stuck, second floor
events.text: Since about 08:00 UTC no print job from the second floor leaves the queue. Every job shows Printing and never finishes. The first floor prints normally. About 40 people are affected.

events.title: Re: Printing stuck, second floor
events.text: Hello, thank you. Which print server hosts the queue, and does the queue show Error or Paused anywhere? Please also send me the name of one affected printer.

events.title: Re: Printing stuck, second floor
events.text: The server is PRN02, the printer is PRT-2F-East. The queue status says Printing, there is no Error. We restarted the printer and it made no difference.

events.title: Spooler check on PRN02
events.text: The Print Spooler service on PRN02 is running. The spool folder holds 212 files, the oldest from 07:58 UTC. The file at the head of the queue has a size of 0 KB.

events.title: A job at the head of the queue
events.text: The job at the head of the queue is a zero-byte file and blocks everything behind it. Please stop the Print Spooler service on PRN02, delete the files in the spool folder and start the service again.

events.title: Re: A job at the head of the queue
events.text: Done at 09:42 UTC. The queue is empty and a test page printed on PRT-2F-East.

events.title: Check on the queues
events.text: Check at 10:15 UTC: the queues of all second floor printers are empty and 15 jobs completed in the last half hour.

events.title: Closing note
events.text: The cause was a corrupt job at the head of the queue. If it comes back, please send me the time and the name of the user who printed first. I am closing the case.
